Index of ▶Grande Ganadors

Mid-boss: Specially-rigged Frigate "Every Pirates Elite Fleet"

Defeating Every unlocks:
Mohri Motonari (new Grande Ganador)
Pirate King's Coin (recipe is at Treasure Inspector until you defeat another Grande Ganador or until you craft it once; item for Sea Conquerors' Secret Treasure (No.1) Memorial Album)

Special Abilities:
Magic Attack - Damages ship durability/crew, causes Heavy Wave status (slows vessel)
Tornado - While engulfed in a dark cloud, Every's Melee power is enhanced, Aboardage range is extended, and Sailors lost in Melee cannot be recovered with Surgery

May drop the following:

Aurangzeb's Ring (item for Sea Conquerors' Secret Treasure (No.1) Memorial Album)
Commander's Wooden Paneling (Crimson)
Skull (ship decoration)
Shen Nung's Medicinal Herbs x5
Seal of condemnation
Seal of Valkyrie
Crystal Eye
Pegasus Feather
Cannonsmith's Forging Tools
Special Large 2-decked Hull
Custom Large 2 decked Row Boat
Legendary Craftsman's Carpentry Tools (amount varies)
Distant Sea's Logbook (amount varies; from x1-4)
Patriot Award
Broken Cannon
Ripped Sails
Broken Armour
